reason:
The Platform CP authorization issuer is not yet deployed, so no authorization run id exists. Gate item 9 binds three terms and the middle one is the authorized plan, so `build_receipt` correctly refuses to construct a receipt at all. Lane 3 executes once the issuer, the lease and the controller identity exist.

**How this maps to the adopted baseline.** The accepted count was *8 closed, 4 controller-dependent, 3 blocked, 1 vacuous*, stated in the OLD vocabulary where "closed" included hand measurements. In this vocabulary nothing is closed until a controller executed it, so the same facts render as **0 executed_passed, 7 hand_measured, 4 not_executed, 4 blocked, 1 vacuous**. Nothing was downgraded on the merits: items 13 and 15 were one "closed" each in the old count while only their positive-control halves were measured, and here item 13 is `blocked` because its negative half needs the fixture running. The publication-relevant number was always zero.
